Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment (PXD013431) specifically compares breast cancer patients who achieved complete remission (CR) versus those who did not (nCR) following chemotherapy. While the paper describes extensive in vitro perturbations (YARS overexpression, LCL161, ABT-263), these were performed using cell viability and Western blot assays, not the mass spectrometry proteomics analysis. The MS analysis was limited to the clinical case-control comparison of FFPE needle biopsies.
